comparison.objective: Pack selected boxes into a carton according to a printed two-layer plan.
comparison.physical_skill: Interpret a layout, place and push rigid boxes into tight planar tolerances, and leave distractors outside.
comparison.success_condition: Four specified boxes must match planned face positions within 5 mm and settle, while two distractors remain outside.
comparison.reason: Packing tests spatial arrangement and pushing; it has no manufactured-notch fracture, stabilized impact tool, retained-coil protection, or recovery of released fragments.
